title: calibration_head_v1
description: Provenance-rich sidecar for a trained cache-hit-rate calibration head. Records the (predicted, label) training pairs that fit the chosen calibrator from workloads/simbench_bw/calibration_head.py, the per-library version pins, the comparison_contract.toml sha256 pin, and the 7-tuple manifest_pairing_index join keys for every training row so the sidecar is fully reconcilable against data/local_labels/label_admitted.json + the predictor-bundle corpus.

chosen_head.description: Calibrator class name chosen by the simplicity_one_se_rule per DEC-T9. Must be one of the three classes exposed by workloads/simbench_bw/calibration_head.py.

library_id.description: Library that produced the IsotonicCalibrator fit. Pinned to 'sklearn' per DEC-T8.

version.description: scikit-learn version string (e.g., '1.5.2'). Required so the IsotonicRegression fit is reproducible later.

library_id.description: PlattCalibrator is hand-rolled in calibration_head.py per DEC-T8; the library_id is pinned to 'stdlib_handrolled'.

stdlib_only.description: Hand-rolled fit uses only numpy (no external Platt library); pinned true.

library_id.description: BetaCalibrator is hand-rolled in calibration_head.py per DEC-T8; the library_id is pinned to 'stdlib_handrolled'.

stdlib_only.description: Hand-rolled fit uses only numpy (no external beta-calibration library); pinned true.

calibrator_libraries.description: Per-calibrator library provenance. The IsotonicCalibrator entry requires {library_id: 'sklearn', version: <semver>} so the fit is reproducible against the same sklearn version. The PlattCalibrator + BetaCalibrator entries require {library_id: 'stdlib_handrolled', stdlib_only: true} reflecting that calibration_head.py implements both heads from numpy + the in-tree Newton solver.

training_cells.description: List of cell identities the calibrator was trained on. Each entry is the (slug, shape_point, arch) triple; deduplicate across n_repeats. arch is recorded for evaluation-block provenance only; per DEC-T12 the calibrator does not fit on arch.

training_pair_count.description: Total number of (predicted, label) pairs the calibrator fit on. Equals len(training_rows).

training_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at training time (e.g., '2026-05-16T22:14:07Z').

trained_head_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON-serialized fitted parameters (e.g., {'A': 0.95, 'B': 0.02} for Platt; {'a': 1.1, 'b': 0.3, 'c': -0.05} for Beta; the sklearn IsotonicRegression's piecewise-constant breakpoints + values for Isotonic). Allows a future inference run to verify the head was not silently modified post-fit.

comparison_contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of workloads/simbench_bw/comparison_contract.toml at training time. The training row corpus is gated on a specific contract version (epsilon, bootstrap_resamples, ncu_metric_version pins); a drifted contract changes the meaning of admitted labels and invalidates the fit.

training_rows.description: Per-pair training rows. Each entry carries the 7-tuple manifest_pairing_index join key (arch, slug, shape_point, binary_sha256, kernel_signature_sha256, source_commit, ncu_metric_version per comparison_runner.py:99-107) plus the predicted hit rate from the predictor bundle and the label hit rate from data/local_labels/label_admitted.json. The scanner cross-checks every row joins back to admitted labels and predictor bundles; a row that does not join surfaces calibration_training_row_unjoinable:<idx>.

source_commit.description: Full 40-hex SHA of HEAD at training time. Distinguishes the PRODUCER-CODE / FITTING-CODE commit (this value) from the trace's pinned source_commit (recorded in each training_row.source_commit).
